fusions.name: Rehearsed Takedown
fusions.desc: A drilled takedown that deals 28 damage, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Steady Point
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it hits and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: One More Throw
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trained Sidestep
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
